fields.description: Enter approved checks as JSON. Leave blank for checks selected from the captured project.

setup_guide.introduction: Choose a source folder and approve its rules. Four specialists can check behavior, security, compatibility and reliability against the selected scope.

sample.title: Sample task app
sample.description: Use the bundled task app and its short specification. You’ll approve the extracted rules before verification.
sample.expected_output: One report with checks for the request schema, TLS settings, wire protocol and timing budget, plus the source evidence for the rules you approved.
